name: Ichimoku Cloud Strategy - USD/JPY
description: Trend-following strategy on USD/JPY using Ichimoku Kinko Hyo signals. Entry Long: Tenkan-sen crosses above Kijun-sen with both lines above the Kumo cloud (above both Senkou Span A and B). Entry Short: Tenkan-sen crosses below Kijun-sen with both lines below the Kumo cloud. Exit via trailing stop at 2x ATR(14). Position sizing via risk_unit at 2% equity risk per trade with stop distance = 2x ATR(14).
source:
# Ichimoku Cloud Strategy - USD/JPY
# =============================================================================
# Trend-following strategy using Ichimoku Kinko Hyo on USD/JPY daily.
#
# ENTRY LONG:  Tenkan-sen crosses above Kijun-sen AND both are above the Kumo
#              cloud (above both Senkou Span A and Senkou Span B).
# ENTRY SHORT: Tenkan-sen crosses below Kijun-sen AND both are below the Kumo
#              cloud (below both Senkou Span A and Senkou Span B).
# EXIT:        Trailing stop at 2x ATR(14).
# SIZING:      risk_unit — 2% equity risk per trade, stop = 2x ATR(14).
# =============================================================================

# =============================================================================
# DATA SOURCE
# =============================================================================
src = market_data_source(timeframe=1D)()
close = src.c
high = src.h
low = src.l

# =============================================================================
# INDICATORS
# =============================================================================

# Ichimoku Kinko Hyo (default: Tenkan=9, Kijun=26, Senkou B=52)
ichi = ichimoku()(high, low, close)
tenkan = ichi.tenkan
kijun = ichi.kijun
senkou_a = ichi.senkou_a
senkou_b = ichi.senkou_b

# ATR(14) for stop distance and trailing stop
atr_val = atr(period=14)(high, low, close)
stop_dist = 2 * atr_val

# =============================================================================
# CLOUD BOUNDARIES
# =============================================================================
# Cloud top = max of Senkou A and B; Cloud bottom = min of Senkou A and B
cloud_top = senkou_a if senkou_a > senkou_b else senkou_b
cloud_bottom = senkou_a if senkou_a < senkou_b else senkou_b

# =============================================================================
# ENTRY SIGNALS
# =============================================================================

# TK Cross pulse signals
tk_cross_bull = crossover(tenkan, kijun)     # Tenkan crosses above Kijun
tk_cross_bear = crossunder(tenkan, kijun)    # Tenkan crosses below Kijun

# Hold TK cross state until the opposite cross fires
# This prevents missing entries when the cloud filter isn't met on the exact
# crossover bar (pulse + filter problem)
long_state = hold_until()(enter=tk_cross_bull, exit=tk_cross_bear)
short_state = hold_until()(enter=tk_cross_bear, exit=tk_cross_bull)

# Cloud filter: both Tenkan and Kijun must be above/below the entire cloud
above_cloud = (tenkan > cloud_top) and (kijun > cloud_top)
below_cloud = (tenkan < cloud_bottom) and (kijun < cloud_bottom)

# Combined entry: TK cross state + cloud position filter
long_entry = long_state and above_cloud
short_entry = short_state and below_cloud

# =============================================================================
# EXECUTION
# =============================================================================

# Long and short zone — both directions
long_and_short_zone()(long_entry=long_entry, short_entry=short_entry)

# Risk-based position sizing: 2% equity risk, stop at 2x ATR(14)
# risk_unit bundles sizing AND stop-loss (no separate stop_loss needed)
risk_unit(stop_unit=StopUnit.price)(risk_pct=2, stop_distance=stop_dist)

# Trailing stop at 2x ATR(14) from highest high (long) / lowest low (short)
trailing_stop()(distance=stop_dist)

# =============================================================================
# EVENT MARKERS
# =============================================================================

# Mark long entry signals with Ichimoku context
event_marker(schema=EventMarkerSchema(
    title="Ichimoku Long Entry",
    icon=Icon.TrendingUpIcon,
    schemas=[
        ColumnSpec(title="Close", type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=4),
        ColumnSpec(title="Tenkan-sen", type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=4),
        ColumnSpec(title="Kijun-sen", type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=4),
        ColumnSpec(title="Cloud Top", type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=4),
        ColumnSpec(title="ATR(14)", type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=4),
        ColumnSpec(title="Stop Dist (2xATR)", type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=4),
        ColumnSpec(title="Signal", type=CardRenderType.BooleanFormat, table_is_filter=True, table_visible=False)
    ]
))(close, tenkan, kijun, cloud_top, atr_val, stop_dist, long_entry)

# Mark short entry signals with Ichimoku context
event_marker(schema=EventMarkerSchema(
    title="Ichimoku Short Entry",
    icon=Icon.TrendingDownIcon,
    schemas=[
        ColumnSpec(title="Close", type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=4),
        ColumnSpec(title="Tenkan-sen", type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=4),
        ColumnSpec(title="Kijun-sen", type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=4),
        ColumnSpec(title="Cloud Bottom", type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=4),
        ColumnSpec(title="ATR(14)", type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=4),
        ColumnSpec(title="Stop Dist (2xATR)", type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=4),
        ColumnSpec(title="Signal", type=CardRenderType.BooleanFormat, table_is_filter=True, table_visible=False)
    ]
))(close, tenkan, kijun, cloud_bottom, atr_val, stop_dist, short_entry)
